name: The Photographer Too
jem_summary: Expose a real frame from a stand-mounted camera using timer or redstone.

pages.title: The Photographer Too
pages.text: Expose a real frame from a stand-mounted camera using timer or redstone.

pages.title: The Photographer Too
pages.text: Photograph from a separate viewpoint and appear in the scene; film and frames support a group portrait.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Mount and position the camera. A nearby player must supply the rendered view; Auto flash uses the camera-position lighting threshold.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Install a supported flash such as a Redstone Lamp and choose Auto. Fire the flash in darkness according to the camera-position light threshold.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Open camera controls, choose a self-timer and use F5 for handheld selfie framing. Delay exposure; nearby mobs may look toward the ticking camera.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Install a Camera on the stand, position it and release the shutter with its timer or a redstone pulse. Take a remote photograph while a nearby player supplies the rendered view.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: F4 toggles free camera by default: body remains, camera respects obstacles and interaction is suppressed. Toggle restores view; teleport/world changes close it. This is viewing guidance, not server achievement proof for a client key.
